class.name: StyleBoxLayer
class.description: A filled or outlined rectangle drawn as one layer of a [StyleBoxLayered]. The rectangle is the style box's rectangle moved by [member offset] and shrunk by the margins, and uses the corners of the style box.

method.name: get_margin
method.description: Returns the margin for the given [enum Side]. See [member margin_left].

method.name: set_margin
method.description: Sets the margin for the given [enum Side]. See [member margin_left].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the outline fades from [member color] on its outer edge to transparent on its inner edge, like [member StyleBoxFlat.border_blend]. With [constant StyleBoxLayered.STYLE_PIXEL], it fades in steps of [member StyleBoxLayered.pixel_size]. Only used with [constant MODE_OUTLINE].

Size of the soft edge around the shadow, in pixels, like [member StyleBoxFlat.shadow_size]. With [constant StyleBoxLayered.STYLE_PIXEL], the edge is made of rings of [member StyleBoxLayered.pixel_size] that fade out. Only used with [constant MODE_SHADOW].
The color of the layer. Layers with a transparent color aren't drawn.
Added to the corner radius of the [StyleBoxLayered] for this layer, for example to round an inner layer less than the outer ones.

If [code]true[/code], the layer is drawn over everything the node drawing the style box draws, such as its text and icons, and over its child nodes, e.g. an outline over the content of a [ScrollContainer] or a highlight over a [Button]. It's only drawn over the node and its children, not over the nodes drawn after them, and it's hidden with the node. The layers on top are drawn in their order, after the other layers. When the style box isn't drawn by a node in its [method CanvasItem._draw], e.g. the border of an embedded [Window], they're drawn over the other layers only. [b]Note:[/b] Children with a higher [member CanvasItem.z_index] are still drawn over it.
Distance from the bottom edge of the style box to the bottom edge of the layer. See [member margin_left].
Distance from the left edge of the style box to the left edge of the layer. Positive values move the edge inwards, negative values outwards.
Distance from the right edge of the style box to the right edge of the layer. See [member margin_left].
Distance from the top edge of the style box to the top edge of the layer. See [member margin_left].
Whether the layer is filled or only outlined.
Moves the layer, for example to draw a shadow or the side of a raised button.
Width of the outline when [member mode] is [constant MODE_OUTLINE].

constants.constant: The layer is filled with [member color].
Only the edges of the layer are drawn, with [member width].
The layer is filled with [member color] and fades out around its shape over [member blur] pixels. Use [member offset] to move the shadow and the margins to change its size.
